rationale: Correct a stale condition rather than leave it: the behaviour that records how trim derives its bound still said that no execution had exercised trim after a drift, which the drift-then-trim receipt has since done. The statement is unchanged; the conditions now record the executed instance (recorded values 10, 9 and 7 over six indices of content, minimum 7 taken, compacted index 7) and cite the receipt's events, so the forwarded behaviour no longer understates its evidence.

knowledge.statement: SequencePaxos::trim derives its bound from the minimum of the accepted indexes the leader has recorded for the configuration, not from any decided index per node: with no explicit index it uses that minimum, with an explicit index it accepts the index when it does not exceed that minimum and otherwise reports the same minimum in the error; the recorded values are the numbers the re-synchronization path inflates.
knowledge.conditions: Leader role; reached from the public trim() with None or Some(index). Exercised after a drift in receipt ec3329dc273e452aa92bcd44652c116a: with the recorded values at 10, 9 and 7 over six indices of content, trim(None) took the minimum (7) and compacted that many indices (events 9-15), so the derivation now has an executed instance and not only the source reading.
